newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sime seeks to list banking unit in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Sime seeks to list banking unit in 1998.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby Bhd is seeking to list its United Malayan Banking Corp Bhd (UMBC) unit on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange in 1998, its group chief executive said.

Nik Mohamed Nik Yaacob told reporters after the company's annual general meeting that the timing of the listing would depend on various factors including the bank's achievement of the Tier-1 status, which requires shareholder funds of at least 500 million ringgit.
He also said more funds would need to be injected into UMBC to support the bank's growth.

Sime owns about 60 percent of UMBC, Malaysia's fourth largest banking group. A research note on Tuesday from HLG Securities said the listing of UMBC would be good for Sime Darby "since UMBC will be able to raise funds for expansion and acquisitions".
HLG said that UMBC contributed a pre-tax profit of 290 million ringgit to Sime's results in the fiscal year ended June 1996. Sime reported a pre-tax profit of 1.33 billion ringgit during that year.
